purpose: Minimal UI concepts with illustrative telemetry and gameplay; not implementation
portrait: Use case: ui-mockup. Create the PORTRAIT TABLET / MOBILE view of a minimal PS2 web game player ps2-web-recomp. High-fidelity flat screen UI mockup, portrait aspect ratio, no physical device frame, no giant heading, no presentation board. The user rejected previous stat cards and dashboards as wasted space. At top a tiny 32px app toolbar with discreet game title "Kingdom Hearts II", small green running dot and tiny polished fullscreen and settings icon buttons. Immediately below, a vibrant warm Kingdom Hearts II PS2-style 3D town game viewport at correct 4:3 aspect ratio, full width, no stretching. Immediately beneath gameplay ONE very thin dark telemetry strip, at most two tightly spaced rows on narrow portrait, like a Linux system-monitor panel, no large tiles, no cards, no large numbers. Clear compact small text with little blue sparklines and tiny gauge icons: "50 FPS", "GPU time 32%", "Heap 512 MiB", "Audio 42 ms", second row "EMU 82% · VU 64% · GS 58%" with very tiny inline meters. Never label heap as usage percentage, GPU is timing share, values illustrative. Remaining lower screen area is a carefully arranged integrated touch controller on plain near-black background: polished low-profile L2 L1 left, R1 R2 right, central small Select/Start buttons; one left analog stick and separate D-pad below/inward; on right face buttons triangle/square/circle/cross in diamond and right analog stick inward/below, all ergonomically reachable with generous touch targets. Control visuals refined, soft rounded outlines and subtle dark fills with small conventional face symbol colors, NOT a big glossy gamepad illustration or separate panel card. If any control overlaps gameplay it must be translucent outline at 35% opacity and 5% fill so scenery is fully visible. Clean safe-area bottom padding. No bottom navigation bar taking space, no performance dashboard, no telemetry cards, no marketing text. Use the two attached images as style references only: first reference compact tiny monitor strip, second reference functional touch-control geometry. Main goal minimal screen waste with improved button feel and clear but tiny telemetry. Produce only this one PORTRAIT view.
